# Jay Singh Chauhan

Jay Singh Chauhan is a full stack product engineer and designer specializing in building scalable, user-friendly digital solutions.

## Experience
- **Fiverr (Freelance)**: 2021 - 2024. Completed 100+ projects with 5-star ratings.
- **Brand Insights Mafia**: 2024. Graphics & UI/UX Designer.
- **Aciony Studios**: 2026 - Present. Founder and Lead Engineer.

## Key Projects
- **Train Station**: Train station web design concept inspired by Changi Airport.
- **Mevasa**: E-commerce platform for baby products with modern, playful animations.
- **Sales Mobility App**: Field sales management system with real-time invoicing.
- **Think File**: RAG-based AI document interaction platform.
- **Manager**: AI-powered project management system.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- **Backend/Database**: Prisma, SQL, Node.js.
- **Tools**: GitHub, Vercel, Figma.
